input:
CURRENT SCENE:
他发现这个口味，一百岁时候，不小心吃了毒的花。一吃就开始死。但是生病时候告诉人什么植物是药，什么植物是毒。

ITEMS:

[I83] 他【发现】这个口味   correction: 发现 → 有   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: a preference is normally something one has, not discovers
  rule card (near_synonym_precision, Vocabulary): Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <correct> because it means <intended meaning/context>; <wrong> is used for <different meaning/context>.  Her terms: 了completed
  her past correction: [口味→味道]太好 — her note: 口味is for a person
  her past correction: 他发现[-了]黄色花有毒 — her note: 发现is a mental state verb, no了
  her past correction: 他[吃→吃了]一个香香的花 — her note: 了completed

[I84] 一百岁【^】时候   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: error
  checker's note: age phrase needs 的 before 时候
  rule card (fixed_expressions, Vocabulary): Use established fixed expressions and compounds, rather than literal or self-created word combinations. For example, use 自然规律, 制定规定, and 从 + Place.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use the established expression <correct>, not the literal/nonstandard combination <wrong>.  Her terms: 从 + Place, 制定规定, 自然规律, Subj.算是Obj., 只/不过/才(+num.) + 而已
  her past correction: [是大人的时候→长大以后]
  her past correction: [大人的时候→长大以后]
  her past correction: [一个天时候→有一天]

[I85] 不小心吃了【毒的】花   correction: 毒的 → 有毒的   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 毒的 -> 有毒的 (corrected 9/11 in train)
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 他[正好吃→吃到]一毒的花
  her past correction: 他正好吃[一毒→一种有毒]的花
  her past correction: [是毒的花→有毒的花]

[I86] 一吃就【开始】死   correction: 开始 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 死 is not normally used with 开始 here
  rule card (conditional_jiu, Coherence: connectors): Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).  Her terms: 只要……就, Subj. + 就, Subj.+就, 才 Num.就V., 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: [-一吃]就身体坏了 — her note: Subj. + 就
  her past correction: [-他]一吃就生病了
  her past correction: ⟦一吃夹竹桃就死⟧ — her note: it is unclear what the subject is, add “神农说：一吃夹竹桃就不舒服”, it is not “死”

[I87] 一吃就开始死【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: completed death needs 了
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: [-他]一吃就生病了
  her past correction: [-一吃]就身体坏了 — her note: Subj. + 就
  her past correction: 有的人吃[的→了以后]生病

[I88] 但是生病【^】时候告诉人什么植物是药   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: error
  checker's note: temporal phrase needs 的 before 时候
  rule card (incorrect_story_information, Content): Use the story’s established facts when retelling it. Do not add or change people, places, actions, objects, identities, or causes; otherwise it is wrong information.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this changes a story fact; the story says <fact>.  Her terms: wrong information, problematic in coherence
  her past correction: [几棵植物→有的植物]可以是药
  her past correction: 他问那些生病人觉得[这儿→他们吃的植物]应该有毒
  her past correction: 后来神农写[书了→了一本]哪些植物是药

[I89] 什么【植物】是毒   correction: 植物 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 什么植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 哪些植物是[毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 哪些植物是毒[+的书]

[I90] 什么植物【是毒】   correction: 是毒 → 有毒   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 是毒 -> 有毒 (corrected 14/15 in train)
  rule card (word_class_choice, Vocabulary): Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: here the structure needs a <required word class/form>, but <wrong word/form> is a <wrong word class/form>.  Her terms: noun, Adj., Subj., 很多+noun, 这个 + Noun
  her past correction: 什么植物[是毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 哪些植物是[毒→有毒]
  her past correction: 哪些植物是毒[+的书]

items.explanation: It would be more natural to say 有 because a preference is something a person has; 发现 means to discover something.
一百岁的时候 is the established expression for “when [someone was] one hundred years old.”
Here the structure needs an Adj. before 花. 有毒的 means “poisonous,” while 毒的 is not the usual form here.
一吃就死 is the natural result pattern. Do not use 开始 with 死 here.
Use 了 after 死 to show the death is completed.
Use 生病的时候 for this time expression; 的 comes before 时候.
It would be more natural to omit 植物 here because the plants are already clear from 什么植物是药.
Here the structure needs an Adj. form. 有毒 means “poisonous”; 是毒 is not natural for describing a plant.
